text:
maya: Quick check — when Okta/AD deprovisions users we get SCIM PATCH events that currently include user emails and login names in the raw payloads we persist. Are we redacting those before they land in ES? cc @devsec :eyes:

samir: We aren't consistently redacting today, good catch. I can add a transform in scim-provisioner to strip PII and keep stable group IDs. Example of what we're seeing in the logs:
```json
{
  "event": "SCIM_PATCH",
  "user": {
    "id": "u-1234",
    "email": "jane.doe@example.com",
    "login": "jane.doe@example.com"
  },
  "changes": [{"op":"remove","path":"members[value eq \"u-1234\"]"}]
}
```

samir: Proposed minimal transform: persist user.id + email_hash, drop raw email/login. Pseudocode:
```js
if (payload.user) {
  payload.user.email_hash = sha256(payload.user.email || payload.user.login)
  delete payload.user.email
  delete payload.user.login
}
store(payload)
```

olivia: Heads-up — I need to grant `jira-sync` svc acct scim.write for a small canary to validate the change. I'll open a ticket but would like a quick thumbs if this redaction approach is OK. :+1: / :no_entry: ?

devsec: Please open the ticket first and include: retention window, which fields are hashed vs removed, and the test plan. We require an audit event for every PATCH containing a redaction flag (redacted=true) and the hash algorithm documented. Also: no svc-account scope changes without an approval ticket and an approver in the ticket. I won't approve until there's an e2e test proving no raw emails persist.

maya: Will open the ticket now — will include sample events and the test plan. Samir, can you add a pytest that ingests a SCIM PATCH and asserts the stored document has no `email` or `login` keys and that `user.email_hash` exists? Something tiny we can run in CI.

samir: Yep, I'll add the test and a small migration to backfill recent events (only prod events from last 7 days). Will also add the `redacted:true` field to the stored envelope.

infra-bot: [provisioner] prod event received id=evt-9f3a env=prod source=okta type=SCIM_PATCH user=u-1234 redacted=pending

devsec: One more: ensure logs sent to centralized logging redact before any non-authorized dev has access (i.e., redact at producer, not consumer). We'll review the PR when ticket is linked.

olivia: Thanks — ticket created: INC-2026 (linked in the approval workflow). Adding @devsec as approver.

maya: Great, marking this thread resolved for now. Follow-ups in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
